Here, we analyzed echocardiographic aortic root dimension (ARD) in patients with IA to confirm this possibility. METHODS From January 2008 to December 2010, 260 consecutive patients with IA who were admitted to our institution for coil embolization or for acute stroke management and who also underwent echocardiography were enrolled.
